title.narrative: Energy Performance Contracting for Residential Retrofitting in Ulaanbaatar City

description.narrative: Heat loss in precast buildings contribute to Mongolia’s high greenhouse gas (GHG) emission per capita. Precast buildings represent 30% of the building stock in Ulaanbaatar. In winter, with temperatures below -40°C, energy losses in such buildings increase the need for heating and affect the quality of life. Few actions address residential buildings so far. Solutions for retrofitting the existing building stock could be a showcase for other countries with similar challenges. This Project of the Mitigation Action Facility aims to break the financing deadlock by: 1) Delivering energy efficient retrofitting of 375 residential building blocks; 2) Initiating energy performance contracting for retrofitting with different financial support mechanisms and the introduction of a programme that functions like a feed-in tariff for energy saving; 3) Awareness raising, capacity building and policy advice, e.g. on a heat tariff reform.
